title: Expression document check
what: The one statement of the expression document: the check every save and every drawn document goes through, the default faces it starts from, and the shared fixtures both the TypeScript and the Rust check are held to.

title: Expression document store
what: The document in the data root as the server keeps it: prepared once at start, read without writing, saved only by one that names the version it was edited from, and announced on saves a display hears.

title: Expression document upgrade
what: Turns a stored document of the point-and-ellipse shape into the path shape, taking colours and faces it lacks from the default and shortening handles that fall off the screen.
